stopped_items: Read 2 tripped over a create-path bug (rule 106). Run from inside the fix-1276 worktree, 'pnpm session:worktree 9999 --no-install' made the throwaway at civitics-worktrees/civitics-worktrees/fix-9999 and seeded no .env.local. repoRoot() is --show-toplevel, which inside a linked worktree is that worktree. Filed as FIX-1282, not fixed here (the create path is out of scope). The reproduction went ahead on the nested tree, and its porcelain is identical in shape.

That nested create left an EMPTY dir, C:/Users/Craig/Documents/Civitics/civitics-worktrees/civitics-worktrees/, after the rehearsal removed fix-9999 inside it. It is not removed: the only tool would be rmdir, which CLAUDE.md puts behind approval. Craig to delete by hand.

The throwaway was created with --no-install. The prompt's command had no flag. node_modules has no bearing on the porcelain or the disposition, and skipping it avoided a ~95 s install plus AV-lock risk on the rehearsal's fs.rm.

D3 touched a file outside the header's list. fixes-integrity.yml lists its suites one by one and never calls fixes:test, so following the D3 'add the one step instead' branch meant adding a step there. The suite was ALSO appended to fixes:test, because the Verification section asks for its line in that output.

D4's HEAVY run was file-scoped, not the whole suite: CIVITICS_DB_HEAVY_TESTS=1 pnpm exec tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/lib/prod-session.test.ts. A full HEAVY run includes FIX-1212's four full rebuilds (minutes) on the shared clone, and cc-200 was live.
The FIX-1276 and FIX-1275 appends and the FIX-1282 filing rode the code commits (076e1418 and 3d1f6d33), not a separate docs(fixes) commit. Same for the cc-loop s7 step, in 3d1f6d33.
No permission prompt fired. That includes the single-file rm of the throwaway's .git file.
